title: Future tense and conditional
description: Będę with imperfective verbs, the perfective future, and the conditional with -by-.

sections.text: An imperfective verb forms its future with the future of być plus the infinitive (or the past form): będę czytać or będę czytał. A perfective verb has no compound future: its present-tense forms already refer to the future (przeczytam: I will read it through). The conditional adds -by- and a personal ending to the past form.
